mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, reducing digoxin metabolism and renal clearance, leading to increased digoxin serum concentrations and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor digoxin serum levels closely; consider reducing digoxin dose by 25-50% during clarithromycin co-administration and watch for signs of digoxin toxicity (arrhythmias, nausea, visual disturbances).
